reason: My workshop already gives me a price on WhatsApp in a minute, and they have done my cars for years. I would have to learn a new app and wait for strangers to quote me when I already know who I trust.
objection: Two partners being added in Riyadh and Cairo means I would be picking a workshop I have never seen, for a car that costs more than most people's houses. Being checked for ID and registration does not tell me if their film is genuine or if their hands are good.
would_change_my_mind: A named film brand with its own warranty in writing, and photos of finished work on M4s or similar cars from the specific partner who would do my car.
